ddr_platform_compat.h

Maps the TF-A helpers used by the ported Agilex 5 DDR driver onto this bare-metal stack.  The helpers are register access, logging, delays, bit masks, and the system-manager window.

Constants
Bit and size helpers

Small TF-A macros. Each one is compiled only when the name is not already defined.

BIT

Bit n set, as (1UL << n).

GENMASK

Mask with bits l through h set.

SZ_1M

0x00100000 bytes (1 MB).

SZ_1G

0x40000000 bytes (1 GB).

LO

Low 32 bits of a 64-bit value.

HI

High 32 bits of a 64-bit value.

Constants
Logging macros

Stand-ins for the TF-A log calls.  NOTICE, WARN, and ERROR print with printf. INFO and VERBOSE do nothing, so the polling traces stay off the console.

NOTICE

Prints with printf.

WARN

Prints with printf.

ERROR

Prints with printf.

INFO

Does nothing.

VERBOSE

Does nothing.

udelay
static inline void udelay(
uint32_t 
us
)

Spins for us * 300 NOP instructions.  There is no hardware timer behind this delay. Callers use it as a timeout backoff, so a longer wait is acceptable.

Parameters
us
uint32_t

Delay count. Multiplied by 300 to get the spin count.

Returns

Nothing.

mdelay
static inline void mdelay(
uint32_t 
ms
)

Calls udelay(1000) once for each count in ms.

Parameters
ms
uint32_t

How many times to call udelay(1000).

Returns

Nothing.

Constants
System manager registers

Agilex 5 system manager addresses the DDR driver reads.  SOCFPGA_SYSMGR(name) adds the matching offset to the base.

SOCFPGA_SYSMGR_REG_BASE

Base address 0x10D12000.

SOCFPGA_SYSMGR_BOOT_SCRATCH_COLD_3

Offset 0x20C. Holds the reset type and the double-bit error flags.

SOCFPGA_SYSMGR_MPFE_CONFIG

Offset 0x228. Dual-EMIF init sets bit 8 and bit 2.

SOCFPGA_SYSMGR_BOOT_SCRATCH_POR_0

Offset 0x258. Bit 0 is the DDR init-in-progress flag.

SOCFPGA_SYSMGR

Base plus SOCFPGA_SYSMGR_##_reg. The driver calls SOCFPGA_SYSMGR(BOOT_SCRATCH_COLD_3) and the same form for the other offsets.

DDR window base

Start of the DDR window on Agilex 5.

DRAM_BASE

Default 0x80000000. Used when the build does not already define DRAM_BASE.

handoff

The only handoff data this DDR driver reads.  Bit 0 of ddr_config is dual-port. Bit 1 is dual-EMIF.

ddr_config

Bit 0 selects dual-port. Bit 1 selects dual-EMIF.

mailbox_reset_cold
static inline void mailbox_reset_cold(
void
)

Prints that a cold reset is required, then waits in a WFI loop.  Bring-up calls this on an ECC double-bit error. This function does not return.

Returns

Does not return.
